verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 has a dedicated GitHub CI integration doc stating GitHub Actions can run the `s0` CLI non-interactively for image build/push, template updates, and sandbox orchestration. An official CLI exists, and Go/Python/TypeScript SDKs plus a raw HTTP API authenticate headlessly through a team-scoped API key exported as SANDBOX0_TOKEN. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI runs, and documentation for CI systems beyond GitHub Actions.
